description: Source code for a Git checkout worker process, handling parallel checkout items, packet communication, and command execution.

methods.name: packet_to_pc_item
methods.description: Converts a packet buffer into a parallel checkout item, handling memory and data parsing.

methods.name: report_result
methods.description: Sends the result of a checkout item over the packet communication channel.

methods.name: release_pc_item_data
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a checkout item, excluding the item structure itself.

methods.name: worker_loop
methods.description: Main loop for processing incoming packets, converting them to checkout items, executing write operations, and reporting results.

methods.name: cmd_checkout__worker
methods.description: Main command function to initialize checkout state, parse options, and run the worker loop.
